description: Verify the org binding by querying the org record through the sf CLI. Returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued' (D0.3 deferred-completion shape) -- the dispatch returning is NOT the same as the job finishing; ok, org_id, the verified username, and the pinned api_version are delivered when the job completes.
embedding_description: Verify the Salesforce connector is configured and reachable, surfacing the resolved org id, the authenticated username, and the API version in use. A health check for diagnosing a credential or connection problem before relying on the query and record verbs. Dispatches asynchronously -- job_id first, the health-check outcome moments later.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch envelope: job_id (string) and status ('queued'). This is NOT the health-check outcome -- ok/org_id/username/api_version arrive separately, as their own message, when the job completes.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This call only confirms the check was queued -- do not present job_id/status as the connection result. Acknowledge the check is in flight; ok plus org_id/username land in a follow-up message when the job completes. Once delivered, report them for the operator's confirmation; low sensitivity (connection metadata, data_sensitivity 0.1).

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.not_configured: no salesforce_org address-book entry is registered, or it is incomplete, or the CLI alias resolves to a different org than the pinned instance_host. sf.auth_failed: the sf CLI has no live session for the registered org. sf.api_error: an unexpected org error.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: sf.not_configured: register the salesforce_org address-book entry per the plugin's KB runbook. sf.auth_failed: ask the operator to re-establish the org session with: sf org login web.
